pr.name AS repo_name, pr.repo_url AS repo_url

sql.if: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = ${alias}.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = ${alias}.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{q.viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')

if.test: q.outcome != null and q.outcome != '' and q.outcome != 'all'

mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.workspace_id, b.req_id, b.repo_id, b.name, b.status, b.target_branch, b.owner, b.outcome FROM dev_branch b WHERE AND b.outcome = 'open' ORDER BY FIELD(b.status, 'dev', 'testing', 'merging', 'released'), b.updated_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dev_branch b WHERE AND b.outcome = 'open'
SELECT b.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dev_branch b WHERE GROUP BY b.status
SELECT b.outcome AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dev_branch b WHERE GROUP BY b.outcome
SELECT b.repo_id AS repoId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dev_branch b WHERE GROUP BY b.repo_id
SELECT b.repo_id AS repoId, b.outcome AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dev_branch b WHERE b.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND b.repo_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.repo_id, b.outcome
SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, b.released_at)) / 86400.0 FROM dev_branch b WHERE AND b.status = 'released' AND b.released_at IS NOT NULL AND b.created_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT , FROM dev_branch b LEFT JOIN project_repo pr ON pr.id = b.repo_id WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS task_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done_count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.branch_id = #{branchId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column <> 'canceled'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')

SELECT t.branch_id AS branchId, pv.id AS versionId, pv.name AS name, pv.status AS status, pv.req_id AS reqId, r.name AS reqName FROM task t INNER JOIN version_task vt ON vt.task_id = t.id AND vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = pv.req_id AND r.workspace_id = pv.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL
AND t.branch_id IN #{bid}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
GROUP BY t.branch_id, pv.id, pv.name, pv.status, pv.req_id, r.name ORDER BY r.name, pv.name

SELECT pv.id AS versionId, pv.name AS name, pv.status AS status, pv.req_id AS reqId, r.name AS reqName, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS count FROM dev_branch b INNER JOIN task t ON t.branch_id = b.id AND t.workspace_id = b.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN version_task vt ON vt.task_id = t.id AND vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = pv.req_id AND r.workspace_id = pv.workspace_id WHERE
GROUP BY pv.id, pv.name, pv.status, pv.req_id, r.name ORDER BY r.name, pv.name

SELECT t.branch_id AS branchId, r.id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName FROM task t INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL AND t.req_id IS NOT NULL
AND t.branch_id IN #{bid}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
GROUP BY t.branch_id, r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dev_branch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND name = #{name} AND repo_id IS NULL AND (req_id = #{reqId} OR (req_id IS NULL AND #{reqId} IS NULL)) AND id <> #{excludeId}
SELECT FROM dev_branch b WHERE b.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND b.repo_id = #{repoId} ORDER BY b.name
SELECT FROM dev_branch b WHERE b.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND b.repo_id = #{repoId} AND b.name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM dev_branch b WHERE b.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (b.req_id = #{reqId} OR (b.req_id IS NULL AND b.repo_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY b.req_id IS NULL, b.name

SELECT , , COALESCE(tc.task_count, 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(tc.done_count, 0) AS done_count FROM dev_branch b LEFT JOIN project_repo pr ON pr.id = b.repo_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.branch_id, COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{q.workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{q.viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
GROUP BY t.branch_id ) tc ON tc.branch_id = b.id WHERE AND b.outcome = 'pending' ORDER BY b.repo_id, b.updated_at DESC, b.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_branch SET remote_state = #{remoteState}, remote_head_sha = #{headSha}, remote_head_at = #{headAt}, remote_head_author = #{headAuthor}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, last_seen_head_sha = #{lastSeenSha}, sync_status = 'ok', sync_error = NULL, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE dev_branch SET remote_state = 'deleted', sync_status = 'ok', sync_error = NULL, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE dev_branch SET merged = 1, merged_into = #{mergedInto}, merged_at = #{mergedAt}, merge_evidence = #{evidence}, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE dev_branch SET outcome = #{outcome}, pending_reason = #{pendingReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET decision = #{decision}, decision_reason = #{reason}, decision_note = #{note}, decided_by_user_id = #{userId}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, outcome = #{decision}, pending_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET decision = NULL, decision_reason = NULL, decision_note = NULL, decided_by_user_id = NULL, decided_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE dev_branch SET name = #{name}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET repo_id = #{repoId}, `source` = 'git', remote_state = 'active', remote_head_sha = #{headSha}, remote_head_at = #{headAt}, remote_head_author = #{headAuthor}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, last_seen_head_sha = #{lastSeenSha}, sync_status = 'ok', sync_error = NULL, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch (id, workspace_id, req_id, repo_id, `source`, name, status, owner, owner_user_id, target_branch, note, remote_state, remote_head_sha, remote_head_at, remote_head_author, last_seen_at, last_seen_head_sha, merged, merged_into, merged_at, merge_evidence, decision, decision_reason, decision_note, decided_by_user_id, decided_at, outcome, pending_reason, sync_status, sync_error, dev_at, test_at, merge_at, released_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{repoId}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'git'), #{name}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'dev'), #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, #{targetBranch}, #{note}, #{remoteState}, #{remoteHeadSha}, #{remoteHeadAt}, #{remoteHeadAuthor}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastSeenHeadSha}, COALESCE(#{merged}, 0), #{mergedInto}, #{mergedAt}, #{mergeEvidence}, #{decision}, #{decisionReason}, #{decisionNote}, #{decidedByUserId}, #{decidedAt}, COALESCE(#{outcome}, 'open'), #{pendingReason}, #{syncStatus}, #{syncError}, #{devAt}, #{testAt}, #{mergeAt}, #{releasedAt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_branch SET sync_status = #{status}, sync_error = #{error}, updated_at = updated_at WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND repo_id = #{repoId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET repo_id = NULL, `source` = 'manual', remote_state = NULL, merged = 0, merged_into = NULL, merged_at = NULL, merge_evidence = NULL, sync_status = NULL, sync_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (req_id = #{reqId} OR repo_id IN (SELECT pr.id FROM project_repo pr WHERE pr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pr.req_id = #{reqId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch (id, workspace_id, req_id, repo_id, name, status, owner, owner_user_id, target_branch, note, `source`, outcome, merged, dev_at, test_at, merge_at, released_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{repoId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, #{targetBranch}, #{note}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'manual'), COALESCE(#{outcome}, 'open'), COALESCE(#{merged}, 0), #{devAt}, #{testAt}, #{mergeAt}, #{releasedAt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_branch SET name = #{name}, req_id = #{reqId}, owner = #{owner}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, target_branch = #{targetBranch}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() , dev_at = COALESCE(dev_at, NOW()) , test_at = COALESCE(test_at, NOW()) , merge_at = COALESCE(merge_at, NOW()) , released_at = COALESCE(released_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE dev_branch SET req_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dev_branch WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch_log (id, workspace_id, branch_id, action, from_status, to_status, detail, actor_name, actor_user_id, actor_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{branchId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, #{actorName}, #{actorUserId}, COALESCE(#{actorType}, 'user'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dev_branch_log WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
